english.meaning: to return something; to give up a rented place or move out of it
english.note: 退宿舍 means to give up a dorm place.

exampleSentences.english: So what about returning the dorm at the Jockey Club?
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉你馬會嗰度退返間宿舍噉點啊？

exampleSentences.english: So when are you moving out of that dorm?
exampleSentences.traditional: 噉你嗰個宿舍幾時退唧？
